semiconductor_relevance: High — Posa Machinery specializes in precision spindles that are critical for semiconductor wafer and LED processing.
summary: Posa Machinery Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese manufacturer of precision spindles, offering a comprehensive range of products including pneumatic spindles and grinding machine spindles. Their innovative pneumatic precision spindle technology provides environmentally friendly, oil-free, and high-precision solutions tailored for semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.Taiwan: Posa Machinery is based in Taiwan, where it manufactures its precision spindle products.
